methods.label: Combine the ones into another ten
methods.explanation:
Add \(8\) to the \(2\) ones in \(12\) to make another ten:
\[
12+8=10+(2+8)=10+10=20.
\]
methods.levelReason: This uses elementary mental addition with regrouping, supported by tens and ones and addition within 10.
